s.note: the breakfast table talk before the heist
s.how: Whisk 200g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 300ml buttermilk and 1 egg and rest 15 minutes. Cook small rounds in butter until bubbles set. Stack in threes with butter and maple syrup.
Grate 800g potatoes and a small onion, squeeze dry and season with fine salt. Press into flat cakes and fry in 40g butter and a little oil for 5 minutes a side until deep golden.

m.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in 30g butter until golden. Sear 2 rump steaks, rest and slice. Pile into 4 toasted rolls with the onions, 4 slices provolone and mayo mixed with 1 tbsp horseradish.

w.note: Mr Pink won't tip, you should
w.how: Toss 1kg sliced Granny Smiths with 120g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp flour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill, cover with 2 more and egg wash. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and rest an hour. Serve with 300ml cream.

d.note: the waitress keeps topping it up
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine. Pour into thick mugs with milk and sugar on the table. Keep refilling until someone says stop, and everyone tips.
